definitions.explanation: The act of closing, concluding, or finalizing something. Often used for deadlines, account closing periods, or the conclusion of an event.

definitions.gloss: final dish (of a meal or drinking session)
definitions.explanation: The last course eaten at the end of a meal or drinking party, typically a carbohydrate-heavy dish like rice, noodles, or rice porridge served to finish off a hot pot or izakaya session.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{締|し}めです。
examples.english: The deadline is the end of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十五日|にじゅうごにち}だ。
examples.english: The expense cutoff for this month is the 25th.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The department head gave a closing remark at the end of the meeting.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have ramen as the final dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雑炊|ぞうすい}→雑炊：04986_zousui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made rice porridge as the final dish to finish off the hot pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{締|し}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Going out for ramen as the final dish after a drinking party is a classic tradition.

notes:
USAGE:
In sense 2 (final dish), {締|し}め is a deeply rooted part of Japanese food culture. After a hot pot (⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧), the remaining broth is typically used to make ⟦{雑炊|ぞうすい}→雑炊：04986_zousui⟧ (rice porridge) or ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ as the {締|し}め. After drinking parties, ramen is the most iconic {締|し}め choice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {締|し}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧ (the final bowl — of ramen, etc.)
- {締|し}め{切|き}り (deadline — a related but separate word)
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{締|じ}め (monthly closing — for accounting)
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}め (final dish after hot pot)
- {締|し}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧ (ramen to finish off a night out)
